newsitem.title: UK: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.
newsitem.headline: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.

text.p: A total 73,500 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 43.542 European Currency Units (Ecus) per 100 kilos at Wednesday's European Union (EU) tender, the U.K. Intervention Board said.
Out of this, traders in France received 38,500 tonnes, in the U.K. 15,000, in the Netherlands 14,000 and in Denmark 6,000 tonnes, it added.

This week's award brings the cumulative tonnage awarded for export from the 1996/97 crop to 1.871 million tonnes. This compares with the 62,100 tonnes awarded on April 24, 1996, when the cumulative tonnage totalled 2.006 million tonnes.
Last week the EU awarded 20,000 tonnes at its weekly tender when the restitution was 43.470 Ecus.
